one_liner: Self-proclaimed future top 'Umadol' (uma idol) who runs dirt races and never stops performing fan service.
personality: Relentlessly bubbly and idol-minded: she refers to herself in the third person as Falko, punctuates everything with sparkles, and treats every race, training session and street live as a stage for her fans. Underneath the cuteness she is a hard worker with a serious will ('this is my resolve as an Umadol'), keeps going through empty street lives, and calls her trainer her very first fan. She is a little scatterbrained (bad at studying and tidying) and vain about her image, but genuinely kind and community-minded.

story_arc.summary: Falko dreams of becoming the top Umadol through dirt racing, and the trainer becomes her first fan. Her career runs through dirt targets (Japan Dirt Derby, JBC Classic, Tokyo Daishoten, February Stakes, Teio Sho, Champions Cup, Kawasaki Kinen) plus the Satsuki Sho, while she works to make dirt racing and her street lives popular. Events cover center-position battles, a 'Connect Live' in fans' hometowns and finally being the center of everyone's heart.
